findings.reason: If the client disappears during the server-eof Closing drain, the connection stays in Closing for up to the full grace and a restarted client waits unserved. This is incorrect behavior on the resume and reconnect path the goal names.
The test is flaky under parallel load (about 1% of runs). It asserts an ordering the design disclaims, and the spec requires the full suite to pass reliably.
A spurious 'stolen' leg_down trace line is written on resume. This affects trace fidelity only; wire behavior, data and correctness are unchanged, and the goal names no trace behavior.
